title: Obelisk Media Kit

rule.dark: Use the logo on dark backgrounds (#0a0a0a) whenever possible.
rule.green: Use lime green (#b4f953) only for accents and CTAs.
rule.noSkew: Don’t skew or rotate the logo.
rule.noColors: Don’t replace the green with other bright colors.
rule.noEffects: Don’t add your own shadows, outlines, or gradients.

needAnythingElse: Need anything else? Open an issue or reach out via Nostr.
